propwash.drone_render.size_notice.title: Drones now at real size
propwash.drone_render.size_notice.messag: Drones now show at their real size (1.0× instead of 1.75×), so their speed looks real. To change it back: Configurator → Display → Drone size.
propwash.drone_render.shadow.tip: Drone shadows on the ground. With a shader pack the pack draws the shadows, and in FPV flight your own drone casts one too. Off: no drone shadows, not even with a shader pack.
propwash.drone_render.fpv_props.tip: Shows your own props in the camera image exactly where they would be visible for this camera position, uptilt and field of view: the tips at the edge on a 5 inch with steep uptilt, nothing on a deadcat. Display only, no effect on the flight model.
propwash.drone_render.fpv_ducts.tip: Shows the ducts of your whoop or cinewhoop in the camera image exactly where they would be visible for this camera position, uptilt and field of view – the front ducts in the lower corners, because the camera sits above them like on real ones. Display only, no effect on the flight model.
